full_judgment: 61. Mr. Serajul Islam then refers to section 101 of the Evidence Act and submits that according to law the burden of proof is solely on prosecution. The time and manner of occurrence are two essential elements of proving an occurrence, which the prosecution miserably failed to, prove in the case inasmuch as the FIR and prosecution evidence are totally silent over the time of occurrence. There is no allegation as to how and when the appellant acquired the money. In such a position, when the accused himself disclaimed the money and the rank and file of Jatio Party claimed it to be of their party, it cannot be treated as his (accused's) personal money. If there was any criminality/illegality in possessing such money or in raising fund of the party, the entire leadership of Jatio Party could be made accused, not its Chairman alone.
